race.comment: INNA ZOU (2) resumed with a barnstorming win over the 1000m here in this grade after being slow away and held up on the home turn. The extra 200m suits, just has to lug the added weight. MINKS WRITTEN (4) looks the immediate threat, having placed first-up in a CL1 at Moruya after missing the start. Is sure to have come on from that and keeps Boudvillain. SPIRITUAL MYSTERY (10) was a big-odds third in a CL2 here last time and gets another chance if she repeats that effort. WALK UP START (13) improved sharply when fourth at Queanbeyan and is a genuine place chance, though his long win drought keeps him below the top few.
